en: Improved `--debug` output for hooks: command hooks on tool calls, prompts, SessionStart and Stop now log their command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish, so a slow hook is identifiable
zh: 改进 hook 的 `--debug` 输出：工具调用、prompt、SessionStart 和 Stop 上的命令 hook 现在会在完成时记录其命令、plugin、结果和耗时，便于识别慢 hook
